name: Once Upon a Child
source: Mi, a 10-year old girl in elementary school, is bullied in class by the other pupils because of her name. One day, the teacher comes up with an essay: "Write a story about yourself!" Completely clueless about what to write, she will have three days to finish her homework, helped by her father and Wendy, her only friend...
translation: 米是一名10岁的女小学生，因为自己的名字受到同学欺负。一天，老师布置了“写一个关于自己的故事！”的作文。完全不知道该写什么的她有三天时间完成作业，在父亲和唯一的朋友温蒂的帮助下……
